newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - British budget economic forecasts.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - British budget economic forecasts.

text.p: Following is a selection of reactions to economic forecasts contained in Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke's 1996 annual budget statement.
MARIAM BELL, ECONOMIST AT ROYAL BANK OF SCOTLAND

Commenting during Clarke's speech. "The government's 1997 GDP forecast has been revised up to 3.5 percent from 3.25 percent in the summer economic forecast. This by itself would lower PSBR projections from the summer economic forecast's 23.5 billion sterling."
